cues: Under high power, striated muscle is a stack of repeating units.
Between two Z lines lies one sarcomere, the unit of contraction, about two point four micrometres long at rest.
Thick myosin filaments sit in the middle and make the dark A band.
Thin actin filaments are anchored to the Z lines and make the light I band.
The middle of the A band, with myosin only, is the H zone.
